ctx.x: Arstella had presented herself to me after a concert at the Edouard 7th theatre, my first or second one, and told me that she knew a little girl in Rochester whom I called my niece but she actually was not related to me. I never knew how Arstella happened to come across to France,and as a singer. I had never heard of her in the States, but she had a nice voice in the style of Ella Fitzgerald, when she sang sweet numbers.

Paul Vernon I had met soon after I came to Paris. He played tenor in the style of Dexter Gordon whom he admired with a little mixture of Prez(Lester Young). As for Jack Dieval, he was a good business man who probably had classical training on the piano and came into the jazz field because he liked that type of music and especially the blues. He was avery good accompanist. Soudieux was one of those solid bass players whose interest was not in being a soloist, but backing up instrumental soloist with the correct…

Felix Debrit who had asked me in Paris when I met him during the festival about leading an orchestra in the Chikito came to see me in Geneva, with Johnny Simmen. Johnny came along to help Felix persuade me into taking a group into the Chikito and they succeeded. I accepted the offer. Not because I wanted to be a leader. I never felt as though I had the qualifications to be one, but I decided to give it a try.
